answer.verdict: An open port with no host controller returns scePadStateDiscon (0). Port 0 stays the keyboard plus the first gamepad. Port 1+ is connected only when another host gamepad exists. scePadRead on an empty port returns 0 and fills 32 bytes with 0xFF. pr8 tests 447/447.

facts.c: pr8 branch pad-empty-port-disconnected is upstream eb8688b. Tracked diff is only Pad.cpp and pad_input_tests.cpp. Untracked build_pr_tests.cmd was already in the worktree and was not edited.
facts.ref: git rev-parse HEAD eb8688b2fd191129f103a39543002c005b33409c; git status --short

facts.c: Port 0 is always host-connected. Later ports are connected only when findNthGamepad(port) >= 0. Default query needs a raylib window. setPadTestHostGamepadCount(-1) keeps that query; 0..4 pretends that many gamepads, and findFirstGamepad ignores it.
Empty open port: scePadRead memset 0xFF and returns 0. Port 0 still uses the backend, else the first gamepad plus the keyboard. Port 1+ is sampled from findNthGamepad only.
scePadGetState is stable only when the port is open and connected. Info, req, mode, actuator, pressure, and vref calls return 0 on an empty port and do not queue EXECCMD.

Tests: one pretended gamepad makes open port 1 Discon / scePadRead 0 / 0xFF while port 0 stays STABLE and digital. Two pretended gamepads make port 1 STABLE, read 1, match the port 0 override, and still take EXECCMD then STABLE.
